cards.title: Pages are made of tags
cards.body:
A web page is written in HTML. Tags in angle brackets wrap your content: `

` starts a heading and `

` ends it. Edit the example and watch the preview change.

hi.title: Pages tags se bante hain
hi.body:
Web page HTML mein likha jaata hai. Angle brackets wale tags aapke content ko gherte hain: `

` heading shuru karta hai aur `

` use khatam karta hai. Example badlo aur preview badalta dekho.

cards.title: Bigger and smaller headings
cards.body: There are six heading levels, from `<h1>` (biggest) to `<h6>` (smallest). Try changing the numbers.

hi.title: Badi aur chhoti headings
hi.body: Heading ke chhe levels hote hain, `<h1>` (sabse badi) se `<h6>` (sabse chhoti) tak. Numbers badal kar dekho.

cards.title: Close what you open
cards.body:
Every opening tag like `

` needs its closing tag `

`, with a slash. Browsers try to fix mistakes, but don't rely on it.

hi.title: Jo kholo, use band karo
hi.body:
Har opening tag jaise `

` ko apna closing tag `

` chahiye, slash ke saath. Browsers galtiyan theek karne ki koshish karte hain, par us par bharosa mat karo.

cards.title: Spot the bug
cards.body: The second heading never ends, so everything after it grows big. Tap the broken line.

bug.fix:
Line 2 opens `

` a second time instead of closing it. The end tag needs a slash: `

`.

hi.title: Bug dhoondo
hi.body: Doosri heading kabhi khatam nahi hoti, isliye uske baad sab kuch bada ho jaata hai. Tooti hui line par tap karo.
hi.fix:
Line 2 `

` ko band karne ki jagah dobara kholti hai. End tag ko slash chahiye: `

`.

check.question: Which line makes a heading?
check.explanation: `<h1>` is a heading. `<head>` is a different part of a page, and `<heading>` is not an HTML tag.

hi.question: Kaunsi line heading banati hai?
hi.explanation: `<h1>` heading hai. `<head>` page ka ek alag hissa hai, aur `<heading>` koi HTML tag hi nahi hai.

exercise.prompt: Make a page with one main heading that says exactly `Hello, web!`
exercise.promptHi: Ek page banao jismein ek main heading ho jo bilkul `Hello, web!` kahe.
